facts.fact: Agence Ecofin says Mauritania has been connected to the ACE cable since 2011 and still depends heavily on it, with no fully operational alternative, so ACE outages disrupt internet nationwide; ACE is the single route in service.

note: Second cable (EllaLink, 200 Gbps, coastal section landed Nouadhibou 4 May 2026, commissioning expected January 2027) is not yet in service.
